name: Hibridya
source:
Hibridya is a fantasy, romance, and slice-of-life visual novel that tells the story of Alice, a 17-year-old girl living an ordinary life, until a mysterious event suddenly transports her to an unknown place. It is a realm inhabited by the very magical beings she has long admired and only ever encountered in stories.

This is the world of hybrids: Hibridya. It is a world that has held a deep connection to Earth since its inception, and one that harbors a great secret. A secret known only to a select few… While wandering in search of help, Alice encounters individuals who insist that she is a princess named Evangeline, the princess of the very kingdom in which she now finds herself.

Amidst all this, she ends up being saved by a mysterious young man who takes her to a place where she meets those who will become her future housemates while she searches for a way to return home.

Alice will make new friends, learn new things, and discover more about herself! On top of that, she might (or might not) find herself in a romance!

How did Alice end up in Hibridya so mysteriously, and why was she mistaken for the princess of this realm? How will she manage to return home? Will she actually be able to do it?

[Translated from [url=https://coloragames.itch.io/hibridya]Itch.io[/url]]
